content.text:
Observed source:

- [FunderSummary.svelte:81](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/FunderSummary.svelte:81) uses the member summary grid. There are no `.funder-summary-top` CSS overrides under `frontend/src`.
- [styles.css:1096](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/styles.css:1096) allocates columns in a `0.85fr / 1.15fr` ratio, with a 48px gap. The timeline loses another 32px to its left padding at line 1105.
- The pie is capped at 200px ([styles.css:1199](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/styles.css:1199)); its SVG is square ([FunderSummary.svelte:95](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/FunderSummary.svelte:95)). The legend underneath adds variable height.
- The timeline fills its available width ([styles.css:1159](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/styles.css:1159)), with a `560 × 360` viewBox ([RegistrationTimeline.svelte:68](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/RegistrationTimeline.svelte:68)). Its height therefore follows its width.
- Party funding has a subtitle before its graphic, while the timeline goes straight from heading to SVG. Their graphics do not share a top alignment.
- Bars use a relative scale with 314 viewBox units of vertical range ([RegistrationTimeline.svelte:84](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/RegistrationTimeline.svelte:84)). Enlarging the chart preserves short bars relative to a large monthly peak.

Inference: the imbalance comes from independent sizing rules and content height, rather than a single shared chart size. Whether the reported small bar is the whole chart or individual bars requires visual confirmation.

| Option | Benefit | Tradeoff |
|---|---|---|
| Wider timeline with compact party panel. Recommended. | Give monthly data more horizontal space, use a roughly 200–240px pie, and put its legend beside it where space allows. Align graphic tops. | Panels remain intentionally different sizes. |
| Equal columns with a shared plot height | Predictable alignment and a more balanced pair. Keep the pie modest and make the timeline taller. | Less timeline width; long party legends can still extend below the plots. |
| Full-width timeline beneath party summary | Most readable dates and monthly bars. Party graphic and legend form a compact row above. | Uses more vertical space; the charts are no longer adjacent. |
| Replace the pie with horizontal party bars | Both views use bars, and party names and amounts can be readable directly. | Changes the chart interaction and weakens the immediate whole-to-share impression. |

Favor readable labels and balanced visual weight over identical outer boxes. Matching box heights alone can leave a small pie surrounded by empty space.
